blocks.text: Electrolysis ke doran musbat ions (cations) cathode ki taraf jate aur us se electrons hasil karte hain: Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s), aur 2H+(aq) + 2e- se H2(g). Electrons ka hasil karna reduction hai, aur yeh hamesha cathode par hota hai. Bane hue metal atoms cathode par tah ke taur par jam sakte hain ya cell mein pighli tah bana sakte hain; hydrogen gas bulbulon mein nikal jati hai. Manfi ions (anions) anode ki taraf jate aur use electrons dete hain: 2Cl-(aq) se Cl2(g) + 2e-, aur 4OH-(aq) se O2(g) + 2H2O(l) + 4e-. Electrons ka khona oxidation hai, aur yeh hamesha anode par hota hai.

Is liye electrolysis redox reaction hai. Jab pighla zinc chloride electrolyse kiya jaye to cathode reaction Zn2+(l) + 2e- se Zn(s) (reduction) aur anode reaction 2Cl-(l) se Cl2(g) + 2e- (oxidation) hai; anode par electrons ka khona cathode par hasil hone ko balance karta hai, aur kul reaction ZnCl2(l) se Zn(s) + Cl2(g) hai.

blocks.caption: Electrode reactions
rows: Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu; 2H+ + 2e- se H2; Zn2+ + 2e- se Zn

blocks.prompt: Pighla copper(II) bromide inert electrodes se electrolyse kiya jata hai. Kaun se ions maujood hain, copper kahan banta hai, aur dono half-equations kya hain (Quick Check 10.4)?
blocks.explanation: Cu2+ aur Br- ions maujood hain. Copper cathode par banta hai, Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu, aur bromine anode par, 2Br- se Br2 + 2e-. Kul CuBr2(l) se Cu(s) + Br2.

items: Cathode: cations electrons hasil karte hain, reduction (Cu2+ se Cu, H+ se H2). Anode: anions electrons khote hain, oxidation (Cl- se Cl2, OH- se O2). Pighla ZnCl2 cathode par Zn aur anode par Cl2 deta hai; electrolysis redox hai.
